newsitem.title: USA: FDA does not ok Duramed's generic Premarin.
newsitem.headline: FDA does not ok Duramed's generic Premarin.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration said Monday that at this time it will not approve synthetic generic forms of the estrogen-replacement drug Premarin.
A spokewoman for the FDA said an application was submitted by Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc.
The FDA said it would not approve the generic version because current data do not show that it has the same active ingredients as the brand-name drug.
Premarin is manufactured by Wyeth-Ayerst, a division of American Home Products Corp.
Barr Laboratories Inc also applied for a generic version of Premarin.
